title: Property Listing Page - Resale vs Projects Tabs
description: Enhanced property listing page with tab-based navigation to separate resale properties from builder projects. Implements conditional filtering, separate API calls, and dedicated card layouts for each property type with smooth Framer Motion transitions.
features: Tab switcher with URL state sync (resale vs projects)
Conditional filter sidebar (BHK/furnishing only for resale)
Framer Motion tab animations and transitions
Dark mode support for all new components
acceptance_criteria: Tab state persists in URL query params
Correct API called based on active tab
Filters adapt to property type (resale vs project)
result_summary: Property listing page successfully updated with tab-based navigation. Users can seamlessly switch between resale properties and builder projects with appropriate filters and card layouts for each type. All animations smooth, URL state synced, and builds with zero errors.
